text: The following project load cases shall be combined: dead, imposed, equipment operating, equipment empty and hydrotest, wind (four directions), seismic (two horizontal components with 100 % / 30 % combination and the vertical component where TBDY requires), snow, thermal, crane, pipe reactions, fault loads of the machines (short-circuit torque, blade loss, bearing failure per OEM) and construction / erection loads. Fault load cases of the OEM shall not be combined with seismic loads.
